title: Fix Workspace-Blocking Doc Comment Placement in ui/wgpu
description: ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs lines 12380-12387 place an inner doc comment block (//! ...) inside a #[cfg(test)] mod scope after other items (a //#region marker and preceding #[test] fn), which Rust rejects with E0753 "expected outer doc comment" since inner doc comments must appear before all other content in their enclosing scope. This blocks `cargo check --workspace` for the entire monorepo (confirmed by three independent cargo check runs from different sessions/tickets today, unrelated to those tickets' own scope). Minimal fix: convert the //! lines to /// (outer doc comment) so they attach to the following fn to_widget_node instead, which is syntactically valid and semantically equivalent (the comment describes the GoldenHarness region's acceptance-gate purpose, which reads naturally as documentation on the first function in that region too). No other changes.
